sentences.en: Today, the 16-year-old high school student who railed against Spanish language in his California high
sentences.zh: 今天的内容：这位16岁的高中生曾在加州的高中里

sentences.en: school and grew up to become President Trump's top policy advisor on immigration.
sentences.zh: 猛烈抨击西班牙语，长大后却成了特朗普总统的顶级移民政策顾问。

sentences.en: And as the White House prepares to unveil new aspects of that immigration policy, the story of
sentences.zh: 随着白宫准备公布该移民政策的新面貌，我们将讲述一个故事：

sentences.en: farmers torn between their support for Trump and their fear that he might deport their workers.
sentences.zh: 农场主们陷入了两难境地，他们一方面支持特朗普，另一方面又担心他会驱逐他们的工人。

sentences.en: It's Monday, February 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: We've had hundreds of individuals enter this country through our immigration system, on visas, who've gone on to do enormous harm to this country from 9-11, through San Bernardino,
sentences.zh: 我们有数以百计的人通过我们的移民系统持签证进入这个国家，他们最终给这个国家带来了巨大的伤害，从9·11到圣贝纳迪诺，

sentences.en: through the Boston bombing, in Chattanooga, and on and on and on it goes.
sentences.zh: 再到波士顿爆炸案、查塔努加枪击案，等等等等，没完没了。

sentences.en: This was the weekend that America met Stephen Miller.
sentences.zh: 这个周末，美国人认识了斯蒂芬·米勒。

sentences.en: The United States of America has a terrorism problem.
sentences.zh: 美利坚合众国面临着恐怖主义问题。

sentences.en: A wiry 31-year-old known for his thin black ties and his signature policy subject, immigration.
sentences.zh: 一个精瘦的31岁年轻人，以标志性的细黑领带和核心政策主题——移民问题而闻名。

sentences.en: We've had hundreds of cases of foreign nationals entering our country from other countries and plotting, attempting, or even carrying out terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们有数百起外国国民从其他国家进入我国并策划、企图甚至实施恐怖袭击的案例。

sentences.en: On NBC's Meet the Press this Sunday, on ABC's This Week, on CBS's Face the Nation, and on Fox News Sunday, there was Stephen Miller.
sentences.zh: 这个周日，在全国广播公司的《会见新闻界》、美国广播公司的《本周》、哥伦比亚广播公司的《面向国家》以及福克斯新闻周日频道上，到处都是斯蒂芬·米勒的身影。

sentences.en: And I'm prepared to go on any show, anywhere, anytime, and repeat it and say the President of the United States is correct 100%.
sentences.zh: 我随时准备去任何地方、任何节目，重复并表示美国总统100%正确。

sentences.en: Where did he come from?
sentences.zh: 他从哪里来？

sentences.en: Where did he get his hard-right views on immigration?
sentences.zh: 他极右翼的移民观是哪里来的？

sentences.en: And how will he influence this presidency?
sentences.zh: 他又将如何影响这一届总统任期？

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嗨，迈克尔。

sentences.en: How you doing?
sentences.zh: 最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Glenn Thrush covers the White House for The Times.
sentences.zh: 格伦·蒂尔什为《纽约时报》报道白宫新闻。

sentences.en: So, Glenn, Stephen Miller is still quite young, but his views go back a few years, and they're incredibly consistent, particularly when it comes to this nationalistic,
sentences.zh: 那么，格伦，斯蒂芬·米勒还很年轻，但他的观点可以追溯到几年前，而且极其一致，特别是在他这种民族主义、

sentences.en: America-first mentality that he has.
sentences.zh: “美国优先”的心态上。

sentences.en: Can you describe Stephen Miller as a 16-year-old kid?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下16岁时的斯蒂芬·米勒吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, he went to Santa Monica High School.
sentences.zh: 可以，我是说，他当时就读于圣莫尼卡高中。

sentences.en: His parents, he has described to friends, were LBJ, JFK, FDR, mainstream, Jewish, liberal Democrats.
sentences.zh: 据他向朋友们描述，他的父母是属于 LBJ、肯尼迪、FDR 路线的主流犹太自由派民主党人。

sentences.en: And he has told people in his orbit that as he steeped himself in Milton Friedman and all kinds of conservative authors that he was reading as a kid,
sentences.zh: 他曾对身边的人说，由于他年轻时沉浸在米尔顿·弗里德曼以及各种保守派作家的著作中，

sentences.en: that he actually converted his parents to conservatism, and they became kind of Reagan Democrats.
sentences.zh: 他实际上把父母转化成了保守派，他们后来成了某种程度上的里根民主党人。

sentences.en: So, what were some of the issues back in high school that Stephen Miller took on as a 16-year-old in Santa Monica?
sentences.zh: 那么，16岁的斯蒂芬·米勒在圣莫尼卡的高中时期关注过哪些问题？

sentences.en: A lot of identity politics issues in the state of California at that particular point in time.
sentences.zh: 当时加州有很多身份政治方面的问题。

sentences.en: There was sort of a Hispanic rights surge, and I think he was more a traditionalist in terms of whether or not Mexican holidays should be on the calendar,
sentences.zh: 当时有一种西班牙裔权利高涨的浪潮，我认为他在墨西哥节日是否应该列入日历之类的问题上更像个传统主义者，

sentences.en: and in general, kind of the use of political correctness.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，也就是对政治正确的使用持某种看法。

sentences.en: I want to read a couple of things that Stephen Miller wrote as a junior in high school.
sentences.zh: 我想读一下斯蒂芬·米勒在读高三时写的一些东西。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: Quote,

sentences.en: Glenn, can you help me understand why it would be that this 16-year-old from a really liberal community, Santa Monica, came to hold these views on immigrants?
sentences.zh: 格伦，你能帮我理解一下，为什么这个来自极度自由主义社区圣莫尼卡的16岁少年，会持有这些关于移民的观点吗？

sentences.en: You know, I don't know, and I think it's a curious question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不知道，我觉得这是一个令人好奇的问题。

sentences.en: He's been interviewed a lot about this.
sentences.zh: 他接受过很多关于这方面的采访。

sentences.en: We talked with a lot of his friends and people that he grew up with, and it appears that he kind of sprang fully formed on this issue.
sentences.zh: 我们和他的许多朋友以及一起长大的人聊过，似乎他在这个问题上几乎是一开始就带着成型的观点出现的。

sentences.en: Now, this is not that uncommon, right?
sentences.zh: 不过，这其实并不罕见，对吧？

sentences.en: When you grow up in an environment that is so overwhelmingly liberal, you know, in a state that is demographically changing,
sentences.zh: 当你成长在一个如此压倒性地偏向自由派的环境中，在一个人口结构正在变化的州里，

sentences.en: I think he's emblematic of a fair minority of conservatives who grew up in that environment.
sentences.zh: 我认为他是成长于那种环境中的一小部分保守派的代表。

sentences.en: So then Stephen Miller goes off to Duke, where he maintains his reputation as a confrontational conservative activiSt.
sentences.zh: 后来斯蒂芬·米勒进入杜克大学，并保持了他作为具有对抗性的保守派积极分子的声誉。

sentences.en: From college, he went straight to Capitol Hill, starting in the office of Representative Michelle Bachman,
sentences.zh: 大学毕业后，他直接进入国会山，最初在众议员米歇尔·巴赫曼的办公室工作，

sentences.en: and eventually landing as an aide to the conservative Alabama Senator Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 最后成为了保守派阿拉巴马州参议员杰夫·塞申斯的助手。

sentences.en: This is when he first shows up on the radar of congressional staffers and reporters like Glenn in 2013.
sentences.zh: 正是在2013年，他首次进入了国会工作人员和像格伦这样的记者的视野。

sentences.en: At the time, Democratic and Republican senators proposed a historic agreement to allow undocumented immigrants to remain legally in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当时，民主党和共和党参议员提出了一项历史性协议，允许无证移民在美国合法居留。

sentences.en: Miller had other plans.
sentences.zh: 米勒却有别的打算。

sentences.en: His goal, the first was to kill, and the second was to kill the Republican establishment
sentences.zh: 他的目标，首先是扼杀这项协议，其次是击垮那些

sentences.en: that was selling his party's base white working class people out to the quote-unquote globalists.
sentences.zh: 把党内基石——白人工人阶级出卖给所谓“全球主义者”的共和党建制派。

sentences.en: Miller gets a reputation for flooding people's inboxes with dozens and dozens of bombastic emails about the plan.
sentences.zh: 米勒因用几十封声色俱厉的电子邮件狂轰滥炸人们的收件箱而闻名。

sentences.en: He carpet-bombed people.
sentences.zh: 他进行了地毯式轰炸。

sentences.en: There were Republican staffers on the Hill, actually, who set their spam filters to filter out Miller's emails.
sentences.zh: 国会山上甚至有共和党工作人员将垃圾邮件过滤器设置为屏蔽米勒的邮件。

sentences.en: And very frequently, the subject matter really often settled into one set of arguments, and that was foreign labor is flooding across the border,
sentences.zh: 而且非常常见的是，邮件的主题往往落脚于一套论点，即外国劳动力正涌入边境，

sentences.en: which is suppressing American wages, which is creating hardship for native-born American workers.
sentences.zh: 这压低了美国人的工资，给本土出生的美国工人造成了困境。

sentences.en: It's around this time, working on a congressional race in Virginia, that Miller attracts the attention of people like Steve Bannon.
sentences.zh: 正是在这个时候，在参与弗吉尼亚州的一场国会竞选时，米勒吸引了史蒂夫·班农等人的注意。

sentences.en: That campaign, just as much as Sessions, really brought together a lot of these forces that have currently coordinated within the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 那场竞选和塞申斯一样，真正汇聚了目前在白宫西翼协同运作的许多力量。

sentences.en: He got to know all the Breitbart folks.
sentences.zh: 他结识了所有布赖特巴特新闻网的人。

sentences.en: So there was this whole stew pot, which at the time when we were covering the House and Senate, seemed to be on the fringes.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个大熔炉，在我们当时报道众议院和参议院时，它似乎还处于边缘地位。

sentences.en: But in fact, what was going on at this point was the germination of this group of people who were really tapping into something which would later become the Trump movement.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，当时正在发生的是这一群体的萌芽，他们真正切入了后来成为特朗普运动的核心脉搏。

sentences.en: By the time Donald Trump decided to run for president, Miller is not just on board.
sentences.zh: 等到唐纳德·特朗普决定竞选总统时，米勒不仅加入了进来，

sentences.en: He's considered political family.
sentences.zh: 他甚至被视为政治大家庭的一员。

sentences.en: And then really in the middle of 2016, he became Donald Trump's principal speechwriter.
sentences.zh: 然后在2016年中期，他真正成为了唐纳德·特朗普的首席撰稿人。

sentences.en: At around that time, in mid-summer, when Trump moved from handwritten notes at his rallies to the teleprompter.
sentences.zh: 大约在那个时候，即仲夏时节，特朗普在集会上从手写便条转向了使用自动提词器。

sentences.en: Which was a big moment, I remember it.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大时刻，我还记得。

sentences.en: It was a huge moment for Trump, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普来说，这确实是一个巨大的时刻。

sentences.en: In just a short time...
sentences.zh: 在短短的时间内……

sentences.en: So speaking of voice...
sentences.zh: 说到声音……

sentences.en: You will be hearing from the man who is going to save the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 你将听到这位将要拯救美利坚合众国的人的声音。

sentences.en: During the campaign, Stephen Miller came to have this second role in the giant rallies that Trump held that galvanized so many Americans.
sentences.zh: 在竞选期间，斯蒂芬·米勒在特朗普举行的大型集会上扮演了第二个角色，这些集会激发了无数美国人的热情。

sentences.en: How many children are dead because of our sanctuary cities?
sentences.zh: 有多少孩子因为我们的庇护城市而死？

sentences.en: And in watching these...
sentences.zh: 在观看这些……

sentences.en: How many moms are grieving because of our sanctuary cities?
sentences.zh: 有多少母亲因为我们的庇护城市而在悲伤？

sentences.en: It feels like Miller is at his most intense and impassioned when he's talking about immigration.
sentences.zh: 感觉米勒在谈论移民问题时最为强烈、最为激情澎湃。

sentences.en: Giving your jobs to illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 把你们的工作给非法移民。

sentences.en: Giving your tax dollars to illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 把你们的纳税钱给非法移民。

sentences.en: Putting your children at risk.
sentences.zh: 把你们的孩子置于危险之中。

sentences.en: Build that wall!
sentences.zh: 修起那堵墙！

sentences.en: So Glenn Miller's now turning to the next phase of the Trump White House's America First agenda.
sentences.zh: 所以格伦，米勒现在正转向特朗普白宫“美国优先”议程的下一个阶段。

sentences.en: And it's a still secret set of restrictions on immigrant workers.
sentences.zh: 这是一组仍然处于保密状态的针对外籍工人的限制措施。

sentences.en: What do you know about the plan?
sentences.zh: 你对这个计划有什么了解？

sentences.en: We don't know a ton about that.
sentences.zh: 我们对此了解不多。

sentences.en: But this is something I kind of came across.
sentences.zh: 但我偶然了解到的一点是，

sentences.en: Is the fact that Mr. Miller has now turned his attention to the issue he personally cares most about.
sentences.zh: 米勒先生现在已经把注意力转向了他个人最关心的议题。

sentences.en: Which is guesswork of visas.
sentences.zh: 也就是签证的发放。

sentences.en: And I think what he's looking to do is write some formulation that restricts it as much as possible without causing the same kind of harm that the previous order did.
sentences.zh: 我认为他希望做的是制定某种方案，在不造成前一项行政令所带来的那种同等伤害的前提下，尽可能多地进行限制。

sentences.en: So Glenn, I have kind of a thesis for you based on everything you've told me in our conversation here
sentences.zh: 所以格伦，根据你在我们这次对话中所告诉我的一切，

sentences.en: and what we've seen are the hardline views of 16-year-old Stephen Miller, which he came to for whatever personal reasons, essentially now the White House's position on immigration.
sentences.zh: 以及我们所看到的16岁斯蒂芬·米勒的强硬观点（无论他出于什么个人原因产生这些观点），现在基本上成了白宫的移民立场，我对此有一个论点想听听你的看法。

sentences.en: You know, that's a really great question.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真的是个很好的问题。

sentences.en: You know, again, I can't get into where his head was at when he was in high school.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，我无法探究他上高中时的心理活动。

sentences.en: But I can tell you that in general, this notion of economic nationalism, of America first, is really the dominant ideology in the White House.
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，总的来说，这种经济民族主义、“美国优先”的概念，确实是白宫的主导意识形态。

sentences.en: But here's a wild card, man.
sentences.zh: 但这里有个变数，伙计。

sentences.en: Stephen Miller may have the president's ear right now, but this is a president who has shown a passage and a move in directions that he wants to move in.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·米勒现在可能确实能对总统耳提面命，但这位总统展现出了按自己意愿行事并随时转向的特质。

sentences.en: So I think the question is better for him this way.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，从这个角度来问他可能更合适。

sentences.en: Stephen Miller at 31 may very much be where Stephen Miller was at 16.
sentences.zh: 31岁的斯蒂芬·米勒可能在很大程度上和16岁时的他如出一辙。

sentences.en: Is Donald Trump going to stay there?
sentences.zh: 那唐纳德·特朗普会保持原样吗？

sentences.zh: 周日，在斯蒂芬·米勒完成一轮电视节目串台之后，

sentences.en: Mr. Trump offered a clue.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生给出了一个线索。

sentences.en: Congratulations, Stephen Miller, he tweeted, on representing me on the various Sunday morning shows.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上写道：“祝贺斯蒂芬·米勒在各大周日早间节目中代表我。”

sentences.en: Great job.
sentences.zh: 干得好。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档聚焦设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里当DJ时，你每晚都要带上300件你最珍视的宝贝去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 把DJ台变成一个像是陈列着50年精美老物件的流动的快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Donald Trump promised on the campaign trail to create a deportation force that would find undocumented immigrants living in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在竞选期间承诺要建立一支驱逐部队，去搜寻在美国生活的无证移民。

sentences.en: Are you going to have a massive deportation force?
sentences.zh: 你们会建立一支庞大的驱逐部队吗？

sentences.en: You're going to have a deportation force.
sentences.zh: 你们将会拥有一支驱逐部队。

sentences.en: And we've learned that for the most part, he's doing what he said he'd do when it comes to immigration.
sentences.zh: 我们已经了解到，在移民问题上，他基本上说到做到。

sentences.en: People come up to me, they say,
sentences.zh: 人们走到我面前，对我说：

sentences.en: Donald, you don't really mean we're going to build a wall, do you?
sentences.zh: “唐纳德，你不是真的打算筑墙吧？”

sentences.en: Build that!
sentences.zh: 把那个修起来！

sentences.en: And I say, absolutely we're going to build a wall, 100%.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我们绝对会筑墙，100%会。”

sentences.en: For many of President Trump's supporters, the fact that he is following through with his campaign promises is thrilling.
sentences.zh: 对特朗普总统的许多支持者来说，他正在兑现竞选承诺这一事实令人振奋。

sentences.en: But in the Central Valley of California, it is some of Trump's supporters who are most dreading the possibility that he will keep his word about undocumented workers.
sentences.zh: 但在加利福尼亚州的中央谷地，正是特朗普的一些支持者最害怕他会兑现关于无证工人的诺言。

sentences.en: Hey, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，凯特琳。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: Hi.

sentences.en: Caitlin Dickerson is a national reporter for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·迪克森是《时报》的国家新闻记者。

sentences.en: Can you evoke the Central Valley of California for me?
sentences.zh: 你能为我描绘一下加利福尼亚州的中央谷地吗？

sentences.en: So the valley is this stretch of lowlands.
sentences.zh: 这个谷地是一片低地平原。

sentences.en: It goes from Sacramento down to Bakersfield.
sentences.zh: 它从萨克拉门托一直延伸到贝克斯菲尔德。

sentences.en: And it's a place where farms and dairies are really interwoven with the community.
sentences.zh: 在这个地方，农场和奶牛场与社区真正交织在一起。

sentences.en: So outside schools, you know, schools are surrounded by almond orchards.
sentences.zh: 所以在学校外面，你知道，学校周围都是杏树林。

sentences.en: You're driving down the street and one moment you're looking at the grocery store and the next you're looking at a field full of cows.
sentences.zh: 你开车行驶在街上，这一秒看到的是杂货店，下一秒看到的就是一片牛群吃草的田野。

sentences.en: So they're really inextricable.
sentences.zh: 所以它们真的是密不可分的。

sentences.en: And in the same way, immigrants and also undocumented immigrants are totally part of the fabric of these communities.
sentences.zh: 同样地，移民以及无证移民也完全是这些社区血肉相连的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, the vast majority of the workforce on these farms and dairies, some estimates say 70%.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些农场和奶牛场绝大多数的劳动力，据一些估计高达70%。

sentences.en: But others, you know, when I spoke to farmers, they said, let's be real.
sentences.zh: 但也有人，你知道的，当我与农场主交谈时，他们说，咱们说点实际的。

sentences.en: It's really more like 100%.
sentences.zh: 实际比例更接近100%。

sentences.en: And it's this place that, you know, for decades has had a paradoxical relationship with its conservative values and then its reliance on people who aren't authorized to be here.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这个地方一直存在着一种矛盾的心理，你知道的，它一方面坚守保守的价值观，另一方面又依赖那些没有合法居留身份的人。

sentences.en: So you talk to a lot of these farmers.
sentences.zh: 所以你和很多这样的农民聊过。

sentences.en: One in particular really embodies all the tensions you're describing.
sentences.zh: 其中有一位，完美地体现了你所描述的所有矛盾。

sentences.en: So when I was in the Central Valley, I met a farmer named Jeff Marchini.
sentences.zh: 所以当我在中央谷地时，我见了一位名叫杰夫·马奇尼的农民。

sentences.en: He's Italian and his family's been farming.
sentences.zh: 他是意大利裔，他的家族一直在务农。

sentences.en: In La Grande for four generations, they have a pretty big operation now.
sentences.zh: 在拉格兰德已经四代人了，他们现在经营着规模相当大的农场。

sentences.en: And they primarily grow radicchio, which is this kind of hard, rough vegetable that I find delicious.
sentences.zh: 他们主要种植红菊苣，这是一种质地坚硬粗糙、我却觉得很好吃的蔬菜。

sentences.en: But they grow a lot of other leafy vegetables and salads and they export them all over the world.
sentences.zh: 但他们也种植很多其他绿叶蔬菜和沙拉菜，并把它们出口到世界各地。

sentences.en: Actually, they send a lot to Korea and Japan.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们向韩国和日本出口了大量产品。

sentences.en: What is he like?
sentences.zh: 他是个怎样的人？

sentences.en: He's an interesting guy.
sentences.zh: 他是个很有意思的人。

sentences.en: I mean, he's thought a lot about politics and he identifies with Donald Trump really strongly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他深入思考过政治，并且对唐纳德·特朗普有着强烈的认同感。

sentences.en: But at the same time, he doesn't want Trump to deport his undocumented workers.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他又不希望特朗普驱逐他那些没有证件的工人。

sentences.en: And in fact, he'd like for them to become citizens.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他希望他们能成为公民。

sentences.en: So it's kind of this unheard of ideology in the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 所以在共和党内，这算是一种前所未有的意识形态。

sentences.en: But it exists in large numbers in the Central Valley.
sentences.zh: 但它在中央谷地广泛存在。

sentences.en: So he's really the only person that can quite explain it perfectly.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的是唯一能完美解释这一切的人。

sentences.en: Oh, here we go.
sentences.zh: 噢，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I just want to start because I feel like I want to fully get my arms around the migrant workers who work for you.
sentences.zh: 我先问这个，是因为我觉得我想全面了解为你工作的那些农场工人。

sentences.en: I want to get a feel for your relationship with them and how close you've gotten with them over the years.
sentences.zh: 我想了解你和他们的关系，以及这些年来你们的关系变得有多亲密。

sentences.en: I grew up on a farm.
sentences.zh: 我在农场长大。

sentences.en: I worked side beside them all my life.
sentences.zh: 我一辈子都和他们并肩劳作。

sentences.en: So at a very young age, I was working beside them.
sentences.zh: 所以在很小的时候，我就和他们一起工作了。

sentences.en: So I get the utmost respect for our employees because typically we're working in difficult conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此我对我们的员工有着无比的尊重，因为通常我们在艰苦的条件下工作。

sentences.en: Hours can be long depending on the season.
sentences.zh: 根据季节的不同，工作时间可能会很长。

sentences.en: And I think you'll find that most employers, you know, definitely we can't get the job done without great employees.
sentences.zh: 我想你会发现大多数雇主，你知道的，如果没有优秀的员工，我们绝对无法完成工作。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about politics for just a minute.
sentences.zh: 所以我想花一会儿时间谈谈政治。

sentences.en: You supported Donald Trump in the election.
sentences.zh: 你在大选中支持了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Yeah, I voted for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 对，我投给了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And why did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: Well, you know, I like to spend his entire life building businesses and creating businesses.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我喜欢他一辈子都在建立企业、创立公司。

sentences.en: He's focused on the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 他专注于最终利润。

sentences.en: And I think that's needed in this country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个国家正需要这一点。

sentences.en: So now that he's president and he's beginning to put immigration policy into place, how would his proposals affect you?
sentences.zh: 那么既然他现在是总统，并且开始推行移民政策，他的提议会如何影响你？

sentences.en: And what do you think of them?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看这些提议？

sentences.en: Well, I think, you know, I have some uneasinesses on what's occurring.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想，你知道的，我对正在发生的事情有些不安。

sentences.en: You know, I'm still very optimistic that we will be we are going we will be we are heading in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我依然非常乐观，认为我们会——我们正朝着正确的方向前进。

sentences.en: I'm not going to say there's not some anxiety that comes along.
sentences.zh: 我不会说随之而来的没有一点焦虑。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you know, when I see him essentially filling his commitment,
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你知道的，当我看到他基本上在兑现承诺时——

sentences.en: building a wall on the border and suggest he's going to put more ICE officers in the field and potentially doing more documentation checks.
sentences.zh: 在边境修建墙，并表示他将在实地部署更多移民及海关执法局官员，还可能进行更多身份核查。

sentences.en: But that worries me because I need a steady, strong labor supply.
sentences.zh: 这让我很担心，因为我需要稳定而强劲的劳动力供应。

sentences.en: So do you worry that he could ultimately deport some of your workers and force them out of the country?
sentences.zh: 所以你担心他最终可能会驱逐你的一些工人，迫使他们离开这个国家吗？

sentences.en: I mean, that, you know, it could very well happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这，你知道的，完全有可能发生。

sentences.en: I don't believe it's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这会发生。

sentences.en: I believe he understands the importance of migrant labor to California and California agriculture.
sentences.zh: 我相信他理解劳工对加州以及加州农业的重要性。

sentences.en: So I don't believe so.
sentences.zh: 所以我不认为会这样。

sentences.en: But only time will tell when he was campaigning.
sentences.zh: 但只有时间能证明一切，当他还在竞选时。

sentences.en: And I'm sure you remember this.
sentences.zh: 我确信你还记得这一点。

sentences.en: He talked about his immigration policies all the time and talked about how he felt about illegal or undocumented workers and about all immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他一直在谈论他的移民政策，谈论他对非法或无证工人的看法，以及对所有移民的看法。

sentences.en: So, right, I did not care for it.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，我并不喜欢这些。

sentences.en: But a lot of these individuals who are running for public office, they say a lot of different things.
sentences.zh: 但许多竞选公职的人，他们会说各种各样不同的话。

sentences.en: OK, so.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以。

sentences.en: So you weren't you didn't believe you didn't believe that he would necessarily do it.
sentences.zh: 所以你没有——你并不相信他一定会这么做。

sentences.en: Well, I didn't say I don't believe you necessarily do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没说我不相信他一定会这么做。

sentences.en: The extremeness of Trump, we know he's he can be extreme and he can just speak off the cuff.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的极端性，我们知道他是——他可能会很极端，而且会信口开河。

sentences.en: Is he going to deport those bad, bad individuals that aren't following the laws of the country?
sentences.zh: 他会驱逐那些不遵守国家法律的坏蛋吗？

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: I really do hope so.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望如此。

sentences.en: But we need you know, there's a shortage of labor.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要，你知道的，劳动力短缺。

sentences.en: So we don't need to deport those people that are currently working here and contributing and who are following laws are just here to work hard,
sentences.zh: 所以我们不需要驱逐那些目前在这里工作、做出贡献、遵守法律、只是来这里努力工作的人，

sentences.en: raise their families and live the American dream.
sentences.zh: 抚养家庭并实现美国梦的人。

sentences.en: It sounds to me like you're torn between very deep frustrations with the political system and the immigration system.
sentences.zh: 在我听来，你一方面对政治体制和移民体制深感失望和纠结。

sentences.en: But you're also on the other side, torn by your own business and by workers you really care about.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，你又因为自己的生意和真正关心的工人而感到纠结。

sentences.en: And it feels like it's a pretty difficult position to be in.
sentences.zh: 感觉你现在的处境非常艰难。

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会这么说，是的。

sentences.en: Would you say that your views are shared by a lot of your fellow farmers?
sentences.zh: 你会说你的观点和许多同行农民是一样的吗？

sentences.en: I would say, yeah, it doesn't matter if it's trade or it's labor.
sentences.zh: 我会说，是的，不管是贸易还是劳工。

sentences.en: I think no matter who voted for whom, there's some anxieties going out there.
sentences.zh: 我认为无论谁投了谁的票，大家心里都有些焦虑。

sentences.en: What is going to really happen?
sentences.zh: 到底会发生什么？

sentences.en: You know, I'm in the beef industry or I'm in the almond industry and we we rely on exports and he's ripping up every trade agreement and the labor portion of it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我做的是牛肉行业或者杏仁行业，我们依赖出口，而他却在撕毁每一项贸易协定以及劳工协议。

sentences.en: So I think agriculture in particular, there's, you know, a little uneasiness of what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为农业尤其对正在发生的事情感到有些不安。

sentences.en: So that's how the farmers feel.
sentences.zh: 这就是农民们的感受。

sentences.en: In her reporting, Caitlin Dickerson also spoke with the workers.
sentences.zh: 在她的报道中，凯特琳·迪肯森也与工人们进行了交谈。

sentences.en: What did the migrant workers have to say about their fears?
sentences.zh: migrant工人们对他们的恐惧是怎么说的？

sentences.en: And if it comes to this, do they think that the Marquinis of the world, the farmers, their bosses are going to protect them?
sentences.zh: 如果真的到了这一步，他们认为像马奇尼这样的人、农民、他们的老板会保护他们吗？

sentences.en: I think they do.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是的。

sentences.en: And I think the farmers are telling their staff that they're going to do everything that they can to protect them.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为农民们正在告诉他们的员工，他们会尽一切努力保护他们。

sentences.en: Farm workers are certainly nervous.
sentences.zh: 农场工人确实很紧张。

sentences.en: They say that they're nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们很紧张。

sentences.en: They all know a lot about Donald Trump and they listen to and read his speeches.
sentences.zh: 他们对唐纳德·特朗普了解很多，也听过并读过他的演讲。

sentences.en: But at the same time, in the Valley, they feel safety in numbers.
sentences.zh: 但在谷地，与此同时，他们从人数众多中感到了一种安全感。

sentences.en: I mean, they would say to me, look around.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们会对我说，看四周。

sentences.en: We are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们无处不在。

sentences.en: How are they going to get rid of us?
sentences.zh: 他们怎么能摆脱我们？

sentences.en: How are they going to going to do it?
sentences.zh: 他们到底要怎么做？

sentences.en: And so I think they're finding some security in at least to their eye.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们至少在自己眼里找到了一些安全感。

sentences.en: It just it seems logistically impossible to get rid of all of them.
sentences.zh: 这——从后勤角度来看，摆脱所有人似乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: What do we know about what Donald Trump's plans are, such as it's ever possible to know his plans for dealing with migrant labors like the workers we just heard about?
sentences.zh: 对于唐纳德·特朗普的计划，比如如果有可能了解他对我们刚刚听到的那些工人的移民劳工的计划，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: We don't know a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们所知不多。

sentences.en: And he has a really big decision in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他面前有一个非常重大的决定。

sentences.en: I mean, we know that and the farmers are heartened by the fact that growers associations that they belong to, these are trade associations.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们知道这一点，而且令农民们受到鼓舞的是，他们所属的种植者协会——这些都是行业协会——

sentences.en: They're talking to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 正在与唐纳德·特朗普对话。

sentences.en: And so farmers are really heartened because they think that means their message is getting through to the president and that he's going to at least allow migrant labor who work on farms to stay in the country,
sentences.zh: 因此农民们备受鼓舞，因为他们认为这意味着他们的诉求传达到了总统那里，他至少会允许在农场工作的移民劳工留在国内，

sentences.en: perhaps give farmers an exception.
sentences.zh: 或许会给农民一个特例。

sentences.en: But at the same time, those growers associations are up against another really strong ideology in the White House.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这些种植者协会正在与白宫里另一种非常强硬的意识形态对抗。

sentences.en: And that's coming from people like Stephen Miller, certainly an ideology of Jeff Sessions, who's now the attorney general, which is that both illegal and legal labor hurt the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这种意识形态来自斯蒂芬·米勒等人，当然还有现任司法部长杰夫·塞申斯的意识形态，即无论是非法还是合法劳动力都会损害美国经济，

sentences.en: economy, that the more immigrants we rely on, the more Americans who are going to be out of jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们越是依赖移民，就会有越多美国人失业。

sentences.en: You know, they believe that American business owners and in particular farmers are really addicted to cheap immigrant labor, and that's keeping Americans out of jobs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们认为美国企业主，特别是农民，对廉价的移民劳动力上了瘾，这让美国人失去了工作。

sentences.en: And so they think, you know, if we deport both legal and illegal immigrants, wages will increase and that will bring Americans back into jobs traditionally done by immigrants,
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为，如果我们同时驱逐合法和非法移民，工资就会上涨，这将把美国人重新带回传统上由移民从事的工作中，

sentences.en: including working in the field.
sentences.zh: 包括在田间劳作。

sentences.en: And so Donald Trump has these two competing ideas that he's trying to weigh right now and make a decision.
sentences.zh: 因此，唐纳德·特朗普目前正在权衡这两种相互冲突的观点并做出决定。

sentences.en: And as heartening as the industry groups' conversations may be, there's only one of those groups that's in the White House, and it's the side that favors deportations.
sentences.zh: 尽管行业团体的对话可能会令人鼓舞，但在白宫里只有其中一方，那就是支持驱逐出境的那一派。

sentences.en: Deportation.
sentences.zh: 驱逐出境。

sentences.en: And when we look at the executive orders that have come down so far, they definitely speak more to that ideology.
sentences.zh: 当我们看看迄今为止出台的行政命令时，它们无疑更符合那种意识形态。

sentences.en: There's no telling whether that will change.
sentences.zh: 目前还说不准这种情况是否会改变。

sentences.en: But for the moment, it's looking like deportation is more likely than not.
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，驱逐出境的可能性似乎更大。

sentences.en: Thank you, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，凯特琳。

sentences.en: Anytime.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: North Korea launched a ballistic missile in what seemed like a deliberate attempt to test the resolve of President Trump, who has warned against such provocations.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜试射了一枚弹道导弹，这似乎是刻意试探特朗普总统决心的举动，而特朗普此前曾警告不要进行此类挑衅。

sentences.en: But afterward, Trump never mentioned the country while pledging his support for a Korean neighbor, Japan.
sentences.zh: 但事后，特朗普在承诺支持韩国的邻国日本时，却闭口不提这个国家。

sentences.en: The president spent his weekend at Mar-a-Lago, which he's now calling the Winter White House, golfing with Japanese Prime Minister Abe.
sentences.zh: 总统在海湖庄园度过了周末，他现在称那里为冬季白宫，并与日本首相安倍打高尔夫球。

sentences.en: As a private citizen, Trump used to criticize President Obama's fondness for golf.
sentences.zh: 作为普通公民时，特朗普曾批评奥巴马总统对高尔夫的喜爱。

sentences.en: But with two trips this month to his Florida golf clubs, Trump appears to have reversed his thinking.
sentences.zh: 但这个月两度前往他位于佛罗里达的高尔夫俱乐部后，特朗普似乎改变了想法。

sentences.en: Finally, in the friendly showdown between Adele and Beyoncé at last night's Grammy Awards, Adele won out with her single, Hello.
sentences.zh: 最后，在昨晚格莱美颁奖典礼上阿黛尔和碧昂丝的友好对决中，阿黛尔凭借单曲《Hello》胜出。

sentences.en: She won for Best Album, Record, and Song.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了最佳专辑、最佳制作和最佳歌曲。

sentences.en: Tonight winning this kind of feels full circle.
sentences.zh: 今晚赢得这个奖感觉就像是一个圆满的句号。

sentences.en: But she said she couldn't possibly accept the award for Album of the Year.
sentences.zh: 但她说她绝对不能接受年度专辑奖。

sentences.en: And I'm very humbled, and I'm very grateful and gracious, but my artist of my life is Beyonce, and this album for me, the Lemonade album, was just so monumental.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常谦卑、非常感激，但对我来说生命中的艺术家是碧昂丝，对我而言，这张专辑《Lemonade》具有极其重大的意义。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。
